parts:
Intro with a table:

| Material | n |
|---|---:|
| Water | 1.33 |

\[
n=\frac{c}{v}
\]

<AsyncImage query="straw in water looks bent" aspectRatio="5:3" maxWidth="420px"/>

<box background="surface-secondary" radius="lg" padding={3} gap={2}>
  <math block value={String.raw`n=\frac{c}{v}`}/>
  Where:

  - \(n\): index
  - \(v\): speed in medium
</box>

<box border radius="xl" padding={3} gap={1}>
  <svg viewBox="0 0 340 258" width="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <path d="M12 127 H328" stroke="#267DB0" strokeWidth="2"/>
    <g fill="currentColor" fontSize="13">
      <text x="24" y="24">Air</text>
      <text x="24" y="228">Water</text>
      <text x="184" y="22">Normal</text>
    </g>
  </svg>
  <caption>The normal is the dashed line.</caption>
</box>

{@body const questions = [{q:"Speed in water?",opts:["Faster","Slower"],a:1,why:"Water is denser."}]}
{@body const [answers,setAnswers] = DIL.useState({})}
<box border radius="xl" padding={3} gap={3}>
  {#each questions as q,i}
    <box key={i} gap={2}>
      <text weight="medium">{i+1}. {q.q}</text>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={answers[i]===undefined?"":String(answers[i])} onChange={v=>setAnswers(p=>({...p,[i]:Number(v)}))}>
        {#each q.opts as op,j}
          <radio value={String(j)}>{op}</radio>
        {/each}
      </radio-group>
      {#if answers[i]!==undefined}
        <text size="sm">{q.why}</text>
      {/if}
    </box>
  {/each}
</box>

<LearningQuiz subjectCategory="optics" title="Mini quiz" questions={[{"id":"q1","type":"single_select","question":"Which formula?","options":[{"value":"A","label":"n = c / v","feedback":"Right."},{"value":"B","label":"n = v / c","feedback":"Inverted."}],"correctValues":["A"],"hint":"Faster in vacuum."},{"id":"q2","type":"true_false","question":"Glass bends light toward the normal.","options":[{"value":"true","label":"True"},{"value":"false","label":"False"}],"correctValues":["true"]}]}/>

{@body const [mode,setMode]=DIL.useState("sin")}
{@body const [angle,setAngle]=DIL.useState("30")}
<box border radius="xl" padding={3} gap={3}>
  <row justify="between" align="center">
    **Calculator**
    <badge color="secondary">DEG mode</badge>
  </row>
  <segmented-control block={true} value={mode} onChange={v=>{setMode(v)}} options={[{"label":"sin","value":"sin"},{"label":"asin","value":"asin"}]}/>
  <input value={angle} onChange={setAngle} placeholder={mode==="sin"?"e.g. 30":"e.g. 0.5"}/>
  <title size="2xl">{mode==="sin"?`sin(${angle})`:`asin(${angle})`}</title>
  <text color="secondary" size="xs">asin is not 1/sin.</text>
</box>

<box border radius="xl" padding={3} gap={2}>
  <row align="center" justify="center" gap={1} wrap="wrap">
    {#each ["SHIFT","sin","0",".","5","="] as key,i}
      <box key={i} border radius="md" padding={{x:3,y:2}}>
        <text weight="medium">{key}</text>
      </box>
    {/each}
  </row>
  <title size="2xl">30°</title>
</box>

Closing line.
